cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll finish your weather question first. It rained all evening, and the road was wet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may ask that after I've answered the road question. There was standing water at the bend, and rain was still falling when I reached it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you driving too fast when you reached it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold that question. The rain had started before I set off, so yes, the roads were already wet. You can put that answer down in full.
